dates.notes: Approved by the CLAD Directing Council at its meeting in Varadero, Cuba, on 20 November 2023. The official text's preamble is drafted as a proposal for adoption by the Conference of Ministers; the adopted CIIAAP is the November 2023 version. A CLAD–SEGIB report of 2025 states that the Carta was approved by the Directing Council in November 2023.

status_note: Non-binding recommendation, not a treaty. The CLAD Directing Council approved the Carta in Varadero, Cuba, on 20 November 2023; the vote was unanimous among the 23 member States of the Council. It creates no legal obligation, ratification, depositary, monitoring or enforcement mechanism.

title.english: Ibero-American Charter on Artificial Intelligence in Public Administration
title.official: Carta Iberoamericana de Inteligencia Artificial en la Administración Pública

checks.result: The 32-page CLAD text sets out a common framework and principles for AI in public administration, including governance, data, transparency, explainability, accountability, non-discrimination and human oversight. It contains no treaty, signature, ratification or entry-into-force clause.

The CLAD–SEGIB 2025 report states that the CIIAAP was approved by the CLAD Directing Council in November 2023; the INAP report records unanimous approval at the Varadero meeting. The Carta is a recommendation to CLAD member States, not a treaty.
The text is addressed to public administrations and CLAD member States. It is not a general AI code and does not bind private actors.

verification.notes: Metadata verified from the official CLAD text and two official-secondary reports. The record is metadata-only: no full text is stored.
